requirements.label: foundations
requirements.title: Foundations (9 credits)

rule.manualCheck: Choose three courses with at least one from the Arts in Historical and Cultural Perspective category and at least one from the Media, Art, Culture, and Technology category. ARH 205 is listed in both categories and may satisfy only one of them in a given choice.

requirements.sourceText: Foundations (9 credits): Choose three courses from the following two categories, with at least one course selected from each category. Arts in Historical and Cultural Perspective: ARH 107, ARH 201, ARH 202, ARH 203, ARH 204, ARH 205, ARH 209. Media, Art, Culture, and Technology: ARH 106, ARH 205, ARH 207, ARH 208, ARH 210, EGL 220.

requirements.label: writing
requirements.title: Upper-Division Writing Requirement

rule.text: ARH 308, ARH 400, or any ARH course certified WRTD.
rule.reason: Requires one course from ARH 308 or ARH 400, or any ARH course certified WRTD. The WRTD certification is an attribute that is not a course-code list, so it cannot be checked from codes alone.

requirements.sourceText: Upper-Division Writing Requirement: ARH 308, ARH 400, or any ARH course certified WRTD. The university requires that students demonstrate adequate writing skills in their major.

requirements.label: transfer-residency
requirements.title: Transfer student residency

rule.text: Transfer students must complete a minimum of 12 credits in section II and III at Stony Brook.
rule.reason: Sections II and III are not defined on this page, so the courses they cover cannot be identified.

requirements.sourceText: Transfer students must complete a minimum of 12 credits in section II and III at Stony Brook.

policies.sourceText: All courses offered for the major must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher.
All courses offered for the major must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher.

notes.text: Students should consult the Director of Undergraduate Studies (Izumi Ashizawa) and the department advisor. Majors may specialize in an area or explore more broadly.
Minors of particular interest to Art History majors: French (FRN) and Studio Art (ARS).
Enrollment in any course is contingent on requirements stated in the bulletin, and upper-level courses often coordinate with specific lower-level prerequisites.

Students completing the Stony Brook Curriculum must complete a course that satisfies the WRTD learning objective to graduate. The Upper-Division Writing Requirement is consistent in most cases with the SBC learning outcomes for WRTD. Consult the department advisor on the writing plan.
The major leads to the Bachelor of Arts degree.
